title: WPMS/1195/2006 of JAMAN SINGH Vs STATE and ORS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT
NAINITAL.
Stay Application No. 11122 of 2006
In
Writ Petition No. 1195 (M/S) of 2006
Jaman Singh,
S/o Sri Kishan Singh,
R/o Village ñ Mathkot,
Patwari Circle Pajyana,
Tehsil ñ Gairsain,
District ñ Chamoli. ÖÖPetitioner
V e r s u s
1. State of Uttaranchal through Secretary Panchayati Raj,
Civil Secretariat, Dehradun.
2. District Magistrate, Chamoli.
3. Sub Divisional Magistrate, Gairsain, District ñ
Chamoli.
ÖÖRespondents
Honíble M.M. Ghildiyal, J.
 Heard Sri R. P. Nautiyal, learned counsel for the
petitioner and learned standing counsel for State of
Uttaranchal on behalf of respondents.
 By means of this writ petition, the petitioner has
prayed for the following reliefs:
(a) issue a writ, order, rule or direction in the nature of
Certiorari calling for the records and quashing the
impugned order dated 10.08.2006 (Annexure No. 7
to this writ petition) passed by District Magistrate,
Chamoli ñ respondent no. 2.
(b) Pass any other and further order as this Honíble
Court may deem fit and proper in the circumstances
of the case.
(c) award the costs of the writ petition to the petitioner.

By order dated 14.08.2006, District Magistrate,
Chamoli, has seized the financial and administrative powers
of Gram Pradhan, Mathkot, Vikas Khand Block ñ Gairsain,
District ñ Chamoli on the basis of report of Sub Divisional
Magistrate, Gairsain, on the complaint against the
petitioner.

The petitioner has challenged the impugned order on
the ground that Rule 3 of U.P. Panchayati Raj
(Removal of Pradhan, Up Pradhan and Members) Rules
1997 provides procedure relating to complaint. Under rule 4
it is provided that State Government may, on the receipt of
the complaint or report referred to in Rule 3, or otherwise
order the Inquiry Officer to conduct preliminary inquiry
with a view to find out if there is prima facie case for a
formal inquiry in the matter. Sub rule 2 of Rule 4 provides
that Inquiry Officer, shall conduct the preliminary inquiry
as expeditiously as possible and submit his report to the
State Government within fortnight of his having been so
ordered.
 Under Rule 4 the enquiry is to be conducted by the
Inquiry Officer. The Inquiry Officer is defined under clause
(c) of Rule 2 of the Uttar Pradesh Panchayat Raj (Removal of
Pradhans, Up-pradhans and Members) Enquiry rules, 1997,
which reads as under:
 ìInquiry Officer, means the District Panchayat Raj
Officer or any other district level officer, to be nominated by
the District Magistrateî
 In the present case, from the perusal of record it is
clear that inquiry has been conducted by the Sub Divisional
Magistrate, Gairsain, who is neither District Panchayat Raj

Officer nor District Level Officer, as such, he is not
competent authority to hold preliminary inquiry as
provided under Rules.
 Since the order has been passed on the preliminary
inquiry report conducted by Sub Divisional Magistrate, is
not sustainable in the eyes of law, consequently, impugned
order dated 14.08.2006 passed by District Magistrate,
Chamoli is quashed. Writ petition is allowed. However,
respondents are free to pass fresh order after conducting
proper inquiry. Stay application no. 11122 of 2006 is
disposed of accordingly.
 (M.M. Ghildiyal, J)
August 31, 2006
SKSharma
